preconditions.description: The sizes of the two parts and the number of edges are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= a and 1 <= y <= b for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects a vertex from the first part to a vertex from the second part within their respective bounds.

postconditions.description: The minimal number of colours used is at least 1 and at most the number of edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in colors)
postconditions.description: Each edge is assigned a color between 1 and the minimal number of colors used.

postconditions.expression: all(colors[i] != colors[j] for i in range(m) for j in range(i + 1, m) if (edges[i][0] == edges[j][0] or edges[i][1] == edges[j][1]))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent edges share the same color.
